data.gender_notes: Fasahat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'fasaha' which means 'to speak eloquently' or 'to be persuasive'. In Islamic history, Fasahat is the name of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who was renowned for his eloquence and wisdom. The name Fasahat carries the meaning “Elegant, Graceful, Persuasive” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fasahat usually hope their child will grow to embody elegant, graceful, persuasive and live with faith, good character and purpose.
